war.text: Teyo Verada, whose powers first show at age four when a diamondstorm kills his family, becomes the worst acolyte in the Shieldmage Order, until his spark ignites and he is whisked from suffocation in the sand to Ravnica.
He materializes on the Promenade covered in sand, and Rat adopts him, explaining that he has planeswalked to Ravnica, and Kaya and Ral Zarek later join them.
When Bolas's invasion begins, Teyo uses his shields to protect his allies and hinder the Eternals, expanding one across an alley to hold them while Rat picks a lock.
During the ritual to revive Niv-Mizzet he shields all seventeen participants from the God-Eternal Kefnet's fist until it is completed, then collapses.
